text:
The terrestrial sphere of love,

which lagged behind below, turns

and turns without stopping a second,

and we are condemned to suffer

its spinning like a center.


Pacific motionless, glass, pregnant

with all possibles.

Cold Andes, inhumanable, pure.

Perhaps. Perhaps.


The sphere turns in the flint of time,

and sharpens itself,

and sharpens itself until it wants to lose itself;

it turns, forging before the deserted flanks

that point so frightfully known,

because it has gestated, turn

after turn,

the familiar little corral.


Centrifugal yes, yes,

yes,

yes, yes, yes, yes: NO!

And I withdraw until I blue, and withdrawing

I harden, until I press my soul tight!

translation.title: Trilce: Poem LIX - The Terrestrial Sphere of Love
translation.editorial_note: The translation preserves the rotating love-sphere, repeated yeses, abrupt NO, and the invented verb 'to blue.'
